name: get_chemical_compound_info
description: Fetch detailed information about a chemical compound using its identifier (e.g., CAS number, SMILES, or InChI). Use this tool when you need specific data about a compound, such as its properties, structure, and safety information. Do NOT use this tool for general chemical queries or to search for compounds by name; use 'search_chemical_compound' for that purpose.

parameters.name: compound_id
parameters.description: The identifier for the chemical compound, which can be a CAS number (e.g., '50-00-0'), SMILES string (e.g., 'C1=CC=CC=C1'), or InChI (e.g., 'InChI=1S/C6H6/c1-2-4-6-5-3-1/h1-6H'). Must be a valid identifier format.

parameters.name: include_properties
parameters.description: Whether to include detailed physical and chemical properties of the compound in the response. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: include_safety_info
parameters.description: Whether to include safety and handling information for the compound. Defaults to false.

compound_id.description: The identifier of the compound (echoes input).

name.description: Common name of the chemical compound.

structure.description: Chemical structure representation (e.g., SMILES or InChI format).

properties.description: Physical and chemical properties of the compound, only present if include_properties=true.

molecular_weight.description: Molecular weight of the compound in g/mol.

safety_info.description: Safety and handling information for the compound, only present if include_safety_info=true.

hazard_statements.description: List of hazard statements associated with the compound.

precautionary_statements.description: List of precautionary statements for safe handling.

return_schema.description: Object containing compound identifier, name, structure, optional properties, and optional safety information.
